text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I can't think of a single thing!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Why can't I come up with any good<n>pranks?! Grrr!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: It's no good! Gah! Now I'm really<n>mad!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It appears that Shinko Windy is so<n>worn out that
she's unable to think<n>up any pranks. I should
probably<n>revise her race schedule.
